⏺ There are two ways to lay out the fixtures directory.
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 ☐ Layout

│ The fixtures can live beside the other test fixtures or next to the console tests.
│ Where should the console fixtures live?

❯ 1. test/fixtures/console (Recommended)
     One folder beside the other test fixtures, so every reader of test inputs looks in
     one place.
  2. test/console/fixtures
     Next to the console tests
  3. Type something.
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  4. Chat about this
